name: Banh mi lagu
summary: A thick, glossy pork soup with a large piece of fragrant, tender pork, eaten hot with bread.
texture: The article names a thick, glossy soup, crispness, sweetness, and a nutty richness, and pork that is fragrant, sweet, and moderately tender.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with the bread.
where: A small lane off Nguyễn Huệ.
seoTitle: Banh mi lagu — pork soup off Nguyen Hue
seoDescription: Bánh mì lagu is a thick, glossy pork soup with a large piece of tender pork, eaten hot with bread in a lane off Nguyễn Huệ.
